paras: In St. Augustine, almost every family has a datil pepper story. The datil is a small yellow pepper, and it is very spicy. My neighbor Linda has made datil sauce every summer for thirty years, and last Saturday she showed me her recipe. She buys every ingredient at the farmers market downtown.

First, the peppers are washed and the stems are removed. Linda always wears gloves for this step, because the datil burns your skin and your eyes. Then, the peppers are chopped with one onion and two cloves of garlic. After that, everything goes into a big pot with tomatoes, vinegar and a little sugar.

The sauce is boiled for about twenty minutes. While it is cooking, Linda stirs it every few minutes, so it does not burn. Next, the pot is taken off the stove, and the sauce is blended until it is smooth.

Finally, the sauce is poured into small glass jars, and every jar is labeled with the date. Linda gives most of the jars to her friends. "The recipe is easy," she told me. "The hard part is waiting for the sauce to cool down before you taste it."

listenings.text: Hi, I'm Kelly, and I have groomed dogs in St. Augustine for twelve years. Border collies have a lot of hair, so bath day takes time. First, the dog is brushed for about ten minutes, because a wet knot is very hard to remove. Then, the dog is washed with warm water and a gentle shampoo. After that, the dog is dried with a big towel and then with a dryer, for about thirty minutes. While the dog is drying, I check the ears and the paws. Finally, the nails are cut. Most dogs hate this step, so I always give them a treat at the end.

My name is Frank, and my family grows datil peppers just outside St. Augustine. The peppers are picked early in the morning, before the sun gets too hot. Then, they are sorted by color: green, yellow and orange. After that, the best peppers are put in small boxes, and the others are used for our own sauce. Finally, on Saturday, the boxes are taken to the farmers market downtown, and they are sold in about two hours. People come from Jacksonville and even from Orlando to buy them.
